Thirteen years. Two trailers. One development story bigger than the game itself. The real story behind GTA 6's 13-year wait — and what it cost.

13 YEARS. One game. And a development story that is far bigger than most people realize.

Why has GTA 6 taken so long to arrive? What was Rockstar Games doing behind the scenes? And what exactly are they building that required years of research, thousands of developers, and multiple delays?

In this documentary, we uncover the real story behind Grand Theft Auto VI — from the early Project Americas plans and real-world Miami research to Red Dead Redemption 2, Jason and Lucia's complex relationship, the development of NPCs, the pandemic, and Rockstar's massive production process.

But here's the biggest question…

After all those years, will GTA 6 actually be worth the wait?

Watch until the end.
